registration.scope: Geometry-only development training/validation inventory. No policy inference,teacher labels,CARLA steps or final confirmation. Not yet activated in a training batch.
registration.selection: Nearest signed heading targets -30,-60,30,60 with geometry-id tie break; sampled centreline separation at least13.25m from every historical registered same-map route and each earlier selected road.
registration.historical_exclusion_scope: Top-level run protocol route inventories,including prepared but unexecuted variants. This does not certify no historical vehicle ever visited a nearby point.

verification.scope: Distinct development validation roads,not final confirmation or proof of unvisited historical roads
